decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line that remained on the website across both years and fits the firm's stated expansion into organic assortments, it likely meets aspirations and benefits from enough slack to stay.

Although its visibility seems to have been reduced from a dedicated page to a general mention, it is still on the market, close to the core salami business, and the firm's growth and hiring give room to continue it while results are clarified.

This new organic boiled sausage directly extends the established portfolio and the firm's strategic organic direction, so management would likely keep it for at least another year unless results clearly disappoint.

A multi-model organic chicken-breast line matches the firm's assortment expansion strategy and customer trend toward organic and ingredient-conscious options, making retention likely under current slack conditions.

This product is close to the firm's core salami capabilities and still has dedicated web presence, so despite being newer and somewhat less central than the flagship lines, it is more likely to be retained than dropped.
